title: Milo has a cunning plan

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: It went acceptably. But I have a request for something more... extreme.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It went acceptably. But I have a request for something more... extreme.

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: The Humor Bot developed a personality flaw during the hack.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The Humor Bot developed a personality flaw during the hack.

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: So about that sabotage mission I sent you on...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So about that sabotage mission I sent you on...

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: I need you to speak to a Humor Bot for me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I need you to speak to a Humor Bot for me.

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: I've got a rather... underhanded business plan in mind.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I've got a rather... underhanded business plan in mind.

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: You need to find the correct Humor Bot and trick him into helping us.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You need to find the correct Humor Bot and trick him into helping us.

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: What don't you get? The plan is very simple. You must find a specific Humor Bot and convince him to enter Nola's Berg's property.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What don't you get? The plan is very simple. You must find a specific Humor Bot and convince him to enter Nola's Berg's property.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I still don't get the joke!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I still don't get the joke!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I still don't get the joke!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I still don't get the joke!

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: Because the Humor Bot has been rigged with a seismic pulse which will attract rats to the area via a subsonic mating call.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Because the Humor Bot has been rigged with a seismic pulse which will attract rats to the area via a subsonic mating call.

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: Trust me. I am almost as adept with rat sexuality as I am with human sexuality.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Trust me. I am almost as adept with rat sexuality as I am with human sexuality.

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: I used my measly Seismology budget to employ a hacker.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I used my measly Seismology budget to employ a hacker.

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: Two reasons. One - I do not have the "gift of the gab", and therefore am unlikely to trick anyone into anything.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Two reasons. One - I do not have the "gift of the gab", and therefore am unlikely to trick anyone into anything.

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: The Humor Bot refuses to do anything he is told. He refuses all orders, and wonders around the city at random.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The Humor Bot refuses to do anything he is told. He refuses all orders, and wonders around the city at random.

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: If anyone spots me talking to the Humor Bot, the cunning plot could be traced back to me. I can't let that happen.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If anyone spots me talking to the Humor Bot, the cunning plot could be traced back to me. I can't let that happen.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Were you not happy with it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Were you not happy with it?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Were you not happy with it?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Were you not happy with it?

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: It is not "nonsense". I am almost as adept with rat sexuality as I am with human sexuality.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It is not "nonsense". I am almost as adept with rat sexuality as I am with human sexuality.

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: I know this is all very... unusual. Believe me, this world of commercial espionage is not the world I know.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I know this is all very... unusual. Believe me, this world of commercial espionage is not the world I know.

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: Very good. I'll send you to the Nav Point for the Humor Bot. Just convince him to visit Nola Berg's property. His subsonic mating call will activate, and the rats will do the rest!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Very good. I'll send you to the Nav Point for the Humor Bot. Just convince him to visit Nola Berg's property. His subsonic mating call will activate, and the rats will do the rest!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Did I already ask for more context?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Did I already ask for more context?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Did I already ask for more context?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Did I already ask for more context?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Introducing character number three: a hacker.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Introducing character number three: a hacker.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Introducing character number three: a hacker.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Introducing character number three: a hacker.

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: The hacker implemented my rat mating call scheme through the Humor Bot's subsonic speaker system.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The hacker implemented my rat mating call scheme through the Humor Bot's subsonic speaker system.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I guess it's all about that bass!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I guess it's all about that bass!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I guess it's all about that bass!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I guess it's all about that bass!

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: No, it wasn't that bad. It's called:

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, it wasn't that bad. It's called:

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: I cannot be spotted talking to the Humor Bot.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I cannot be spotted talking to the Humor Bot.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why do you think I can trick him?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why do you think I can trick him?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why do you think I can trick him?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why do you think I can trick him?

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: You trick people into your noodle bar, right?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You trick people into your noodle bar, right?

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: I am a simple seismologist. But this WILL work. Should I repeat the plan again so you are clear?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I am a simple seismologist. But this WILL work. Should I repeat the plan again so you are clear?

limitations: Static asset graph, not a simulation of game code or save state.
Conditions are preserved, not evaluated; route totals are conditional on them.
Only literal assignments and increments are interpreted; other scripts stay unparsed.
Demeanor is an NPC expression, not a relationship-meter change.
Friend/Business icon meanings come from gameplay; Enemy's UI label is unconfirmed.
Routes stop at this conversation's exit; external dialogue gates are shown separately.
